ember_about_text: The Ember Network has no servers: your app finds other people directly, and every connection is end-to-end encrypted. Searches, downloads, and the files you share all travel over it. It runs alongside the eMule networks, so you keep access to both.

wizard_welcome_desc: Ember is a modern P2P file sharing client built on the eMule network. It is fully compatible with all eMule-family clients (eMule, aMule, eMule Xtreme, etc.).
wizard_welcome_hint: Let's configure your preferences. You can change any of these later in Settings.
wizard_feature_dual_desc: Ember DHT, KAD, and eD2K servers work together so files are found even when one network is quiet.
wizard_feature_epx_desc: Ember peers share source lists with each other for faster downloads. Non-Ember clients are unaffected.
wizard_feature_secure_desc: Protocol obfuscation, IP filtering, and credits-based upload priority.
wizard_nickname_desc: This is how you appear to other peers on the network. You can use the generated name or pick your own.
wizard_nickname_hint: Max 128 characters. Visible to peers you connect with.
wizard_folder_desc: Choose where Ember saves downloaded files. Completed files will appear in a "Downloads" subfolder which is automatically shared.
wizard_ports_desc: Ember needs a TCP port (file transfers) and a UDP port (KAD DHT). The defaults work for most users. If your VPN only forwards a single port number, you can set both fields to the same value — TCP and UDP are independent protocols. Enable UPnP to automatically forward ports on your router.
wizard_ports_hint: If UPnP is off, you may need to manually forward these ports on your router for best performance (HighID).
wizard_bandwidth_desc: Set upload and download speed limits to avoid saturating your connection. Leave unlimited if you have plenty of bandwidth.
wizard_speed_test_failed: Speed test failed. You can set limits manually.
wizard_connect_desc: Choose whether to automatically connect to the KAD network when Ember starts.
wizard_connect_kad_desc: Decentralized peer discovery via the Kademlia DHT. Recommended for most users.
wizard_connect_hint: Ember DHT is always on. You can enable eD2K servers later in Settings.

friends_undiscoverable_title: Friends cannot find you right now.
friends_undiscoverable_body: Ember could not register your presence with the rendezvous server, so friends who do not already have your address cannot reach you. It keeps retrying on its own. If this does not clear, check your internet connection and the rendezvous server address in Settings.
friends_chat_locked_body: Its encryption key could not be recovered, so past messages cannot be read and new ones cannot be sent. Nothing has been deleted or replaced: restore chat-history.key from a backup, under the same Windows account, and your history comes back. Everything else works as normal.
friends_firewall_body: Friends can still reach you for chat, browsing and transfers — Ember connects around your router automatically. Port forwarding or UPnP makes connections faster and more reliable.
friends_firewall_body_symmetric: Your router uses a strict (symmetric) NAT, which Ember cannot connect around. Friends who are also behind a firewall won't be able to transfer with you. Enable port forwarding or UPnP in your router to fix this.
friends_how_share: Share your Friend ID, or add theirs with Add Friend.
friends_how_mutual: Once both of you accept, Chat and Browse unlock.
friends_how_priority: On authenticated Ember secure friend sessions, friends get priority upload slots — they jump ahead in your queue. Ordinary eMule file connections do not.
friends_how_encrypted: Chat bodies are end-to-end encrypted in transit and encrypted locally. IP addresses, relationship capabilities, size, and timing metadata may still be visible; there is no forward secrecy.
friends_request_verified_title: Peer's Ember identity is cryptographically consistent on the session this request arrived on.
friends_request_unverified_title: Peer did not complete identity verification on this session. Only accept if you know who this is.
friends_hash_placeholder: v2 Friend Code or 32-hex Friend ID
friends_empty_sub: Share your Friend ID above, or add someone else's. Once mutual, you can chat (end-to-end encrypted) and browse files — and authenticated Ember friend sessions get upload priority.

kad_type_lifecycle_help:
Contact lifecycle:
  Active — recently responsive
  Verified — IP verified by KAD challenge
  Expiring — nearing timeout, awaiting refresh
  New — added recently, not yet validated
  Dead — unresponsive, will be removed
  Bootstrap — seed node, not counted against routing table
kad_stat_kad_users_title: Estimated number of KAD users worldwide, derived from routing-table density
kad_firewall_aria_firewalled: Firewall status: firewalled. Inbound TCP connections are blocked; KAD operates via UDP callbacks.
kad_firewall_aria_open: Firewall status: open. Inbound TCP connections succeed; full KAD participation is available.
kad_upnp_disabled_title: UPnP is disabled in Settings — click to open Settings
upnp_alert_failed_no_gateway: UPnP couldn't find a router that supports automatic port forwarding. Ember will keep retrying in the background. To let other peers connect to you directly in the meantime, forward TCP {tcp} and UDP {udp} to this computer in your router settings, or connect to a VPN that allows port forwarding.
upnp_alert_failed_rejected: Your router refused UPnP port forwarding. Ember will keep retrying in the background. So other peers can connect to you directly, enable UPnP in your router, manually forward TCP {tcp} and UDP {udp} to this computer, or connect to a VPN that allows port forwarding.
upnp_alert_lost: UPnP port forwarding was lost (your router may have restarted). Other peers may be unable to connect to you until TCP {tcp} and UDP {udp} are forwarded again, or you connect to a VPN that allows port forwarding.
upnp_alert_restored: UPnP port forwarding restored — other peers can now connect to you directly.
kad_bootstrap_hint_ip: Send a bootstrap request to a single KAD node. Use the node's public IP or hostname and its KAD (UDP) port.
kad_bootstrap_hint_url_suffix: file from a URL and bootstrap from its contents. URLs are validated against SSRF rules before fetch.
kad_bootstrap_hint_clients: Re-bootstrap by re-pinging KAD contacts currently in this session's routing table. Useful when the network looks idle but some verified peers are still cached from earlier activity. Won't help on a completely fresh start — use IP or URL bootstrap first.

settings_unsaved_leave_message: You have unsaved settings changes. Leaving this page will discard them.
settings_launch_maximized_hint: Open Ember maximized to fill the screen when it starts. Takes effect the next time you launch the app.
settings_close_behavior_hint: Choose what happens when you click the title-bar X. The system tray icon stays available either way so you can reopen Ember from there.
settings_close_behavior_ask_desc: Show a dialog with both options
settings_close_behavior_exit_desc: Quit the app fully each time
settings_max_file_size_hint: Reject downloads larger than this (default 593 GiB; ED2K wire limit)
settings_max_sources_per_file_hint: Limit tracked download sources for each file (1–2000).
settings_max_connections_hint: Global cap for simultaneous outbound download connections (1–2000).
settings_download_queue_wait_hint: Maximum time to wait in a remote peer's queue before retrying (60–14400).
settings_multisource_retries_hint: Extra rounds attempted after the initial source tasks finish (1–20).
settings_download_part_retries_hint: Retries for a source after a downloaded part fails verification (1–20).
settings_add_paused_hint: New downloads start paused until manually resumed.
settings_auto_remove_hint: Automatically remove finished downloads from the transfer list.
settings_preview_priority_all_hint: Download the first and last part of every file first so media becomes previewable sooner. Slightly slower overall; off uses rarest-first.
settings_skip_compress_video_hint: Don't compress AVI/MKV/MP4 during uploads (already compressed).
settings_download_history_hint: Ember remembers previously downloaded and cancelled files and shows them in search results, so you can avoid re-downloading the same content.
settings_history_clear_completed_dialog_: Remove all completed download history entries. This cannot be undone.
settings_history_clear_cancelled_dialog_: Remove all cancelled download history entries. This cannot be undone.
settings_history_clear_all_dialog_messag: Remove every completed and cancelled download history entry. This cannot be undone.
settings_backup_desc: Save your profile to one encrypted file, or restore it
settings_backup_contents_hint: Your identity and secure-identification keys, upload credits, settings, shared-folder list, known files, friends, joined Ember Channels, chat history, transfer list, server and Kad contacts, IP filter, and learned spam data.
settings_backup_excludes_hint: Not included: the files you share and your part-finished downloads. Restore this on a new machine and you keep your user hash, credits and friendships.
settings_backup_passphrase_hint: A backup contains your private keys, so it is always encrypted. There is no way to recover a lost passphrase.
settings_backup_passphrase_mismatch: The two passphrases do not match
settings_backup_export_failed: The backup could not be created
settings_backup_restore_hint: The restore is prepared now and applied when Ember next starts, because the files it replaces are in use while Ember is running.
settings_backup_restore_failed: The backup could not be restored
settings_backup_schema_too_new: This backup was made by a newer version of Ember and cannot be restored by this build. Install that version first.
settings_backup_restore_warning: Restoring replaces the matching files in your Ember data folder. The current ones are kept in a pre-restore folder beside them, so this can be undone by hand.
settings_backup_pending_title: A restore is waiting for the next restart
settings_backup_pending_message: {files} files from the backup made by Ember {version}, prepared {when}. They are applied while Ember starts up. Discarding leaves your current profile untouched.
settings_backup_pending_discarded: The pending restore was discarded; nothing will change on the next start
settings_backup_restore_staged_message: {files} files from the backup made by Ember {version} are ready. Ember applies them while starting up. Restart now?
settings_spam_filter_hint: Score search results against known spam patterns (eMule-compatible).
settings_spam_profile_hint: Relaxed shows only high-confidence spam. Balanced is recommended for most users. Aggressive hides more suspicious results.
settings_spam_db_hint: Local training data used by the spam filter.
settings_search_timeout_hint: How long to wait for global search, source lookup, and file notes (30–600).
settings_save_search_history_hint: Remember recent search queries and suggest them when you start a new search. Turning this off clears your existing history and stops saving new searches.
settings_filename_cleanups_hint_prefix: Pipe-separated substrings stripped from filenames in search and library views (e.g.
settings_uss_hint: Automatically adjusts upload speed based on network latency to prevent congestion. Requires an upload speed limit to be set.
settings_speed_test_hint: Measures your connection speed and calculates recommended limits. Upload is set to 80% of measured speed to keep your connection stable.
settings_udp_port_hint: KAD DHT (default 4672). May match the TCP port if your VPN only forwards a single port.
settings_upnp_hint: Auto-configure router ports. Disable for manual forwarding.
settings_stun_keepalive_hint: Keeps NAT mappings alive with STUN and a TCP hold from your listen port, and advertises the public ports for HighID. Best behind CGNAT or full-cone NAT without UPnP. Auto-suspends on symmetric/VPN-style remapping and falls back to Settings ports.
settings_ember_native_hint: Ember's own encrypted peer-to-peer overlay (Noise transport + DHT). Always on; it runs alongside KAD/eD2K and joins automatically. Experimental.
settings_auto_connect_kad_hint: Automatically bootstrap KAD on startup. When off, press Connect to start.
settings_nodes_hint: Fetch the latest KAD bootstrap nodes from emule-security.org. Useful if KAD can't connect.
settings_auto_connect_server_hint: Reconnects to your last eD2K server on startup. If you haven't connected yet, tries eMule Sunrise. On failure, you'll need to connect manually.
settings_update_servers_hint: Ask each eD2K server you connect to for its known peer servers and merge them into your list.
settings_update_servers_aria: Update server list when connecting to a server
settings_update_servers_clients_hint: Accept new servers advertised by other eD2K clients during peer connections. Off if you prefer a curated list.
settings_filter_servers_hint: Apply your IP filter to newly discovered servers as well as peers.
settings_relay_for_peers_hint: Let peers who cannot reach each other directly route through you. This is what makes transfers work behind strict NATs, and it spends your upload bandwidth on people you are not trading with.
settings_obfuscation_hint: Encrypt KAD UDP traffic with RC4. Compatible with eMule.
settings_ip_filter_hint: Block known-bad IP ranges via ipfilter.dat
settings_filter_incoming_hint: Apply IP filter to incoming peer connections. VPN users may need to disable this since VPN IPs often appear in filter lists.
settings_block_private_hint: Reject 10.x, 192.168.x, etc. from the routing table.
settings_allow_shared_browse_hint: Let eMule, aMule, MLDonkey, and other ed2k clients view your shared file list ('View Files'). Off by default — when off, browse requests get a polite denial instead of your file list.
settings_antileech_hint: Reject incoming peer connections from known leech clients.
settings_antileech_restore_dialog_messag: Replace your custom anti-leech patterns with the built-in defaults. Unsaved edits and custom patterns will be lost.
settings_antileech_errors_title: Patterns rejected by the regex compiler:
settings_friend_require_approval_hint: Always show incoming friend requests on the Friends page for explicit accept. When off, requests from peers you already added as a friend auto-confirm. Requests carry a Verified badge when the peer's Ember identity is cryptographically consistent — proof-of-possession on friend-connect dial-back sessions, identity-binding check on regular file-transfer sessions. Even with a Verified badge, only accept requests from people you recognise.
settings_friend_chat_disabled_hint: Ignore incoming chat messages from friends. You won't be able to send messages either.
settings_friend_browse_disabled_hint: Don't respond to browse-shares requests from friends. Your shared file list stays private, and you won't be able to browse friends' shares either.
settings_friend_session_encryption_hint: Wrap friend connections with RC4 obfuscation to prevent casual packet inspection.
settings_max_friends_hint: Limit the total number of friends you can add (1–500, default 200).
settings_rendezvous_url_hint: HTTPS endpoint used for Ember friend discovery and NAT coordination.
settings_restart_dialog_title: Restart Ember to apply port change?

settings_spam_reset_dialog_message: Clear all learned spam filter data — hashes, filenames, and source IPs. The filter will start from scratch and re-learn from your actions. This cannot be undone.
